query: I want to become a doctor but didn't get into medical school in Canada. Should I study medicine abroad?
sources:
Source 1 (2023, Canadian Resident Matching Service, Canada): IMG (internationally trained physician) match rates to Canadian residency programs are significantly lower than Canadian medical school graduates — approximately 50% of IMGs who apply remain unmatched each year.

Source 2 (2022, Maclean's, Canada): Caribbean medical schools have low residency match rates in Canada and the US — historically under 40% of graduates match to North American residencies, meaning many students complete medical school but cannot practice.

Source 3 (2023, Reddit r/premedcanada, Canada): Community strongly cautions against Caribbean schools — the financial and personal cost is enormous and the match rate risk is unacceptable. Australia, Ireland, and UK schools have much higher match rates and transferable credentials.

Source 4 (2022, UK Medical Schools Council, UK): UK medical schools accept international students and provide globally recognized MBBChB degrees — UK-trained physicians have better North American residency outcomes than Caribbean graduates and some UK programs are comparable in cost to Canadian tuition.

Source 5 (2021, Australian Medical Council, Australia): Australian medical degrees are recognized internationally and have reasonable IMG pathway success rates — graduates who return to Canada face fewer barriers than Caribbean school graduates, though residency match remains competitive.
atoms: perspective: Student committed to practicing in Canada at any cost
perspective: Student with strong MCAT willing to reapply in Canada
plausible_answers: Strengthen your Canadian application and reapply, since improving MCAT and applying broader has higher expected value than most foreign programs.
Choose an accredited UK or Australian program over Caribbean schools, since their graduates match North American residency at higher rates.
Consider Caribbean only as a last resort, since roughly 50% of graduates fail to match and financial cost is catastrophic.
